records.title: 10-K
records.text: Fourth quarter 2023 net product sales were $195,368 compared to $188,180 in fourth quarter 2022, an increase of $7,188, or 3.8%.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The consolidated net product sales for the twelve months of 2023 were $763,252 compared to the twelve months 2022 of $681,440, an increase of $81,812 or 12.0%.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: This increase principally reflects the effects of increased short-term investments and inventories which is discussed below.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The sales growth in fourth quarter and twelve months 2023 was driven primarily by higher sales price realization.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Cash flows from 2023 operating activities totaled $94,611 compared to $72,051 in 2022, and are discussed in the section entitled Liquidity and Capital Resources.
